title: Fox Jam
description: A modification that adds jam to the game.
body:
# Fox Jam 🍓

**Fox Jam** is a small Forge mod for Minecraft that adds sweet berry jam to your world.

## ✨ Overview

This mod adds:

- **Sweet Berry Jam**
- **Golden Sweet Berry Jam**
- **Jar**
- **Sugar Cube**

## 🧩 Features

- New jam-themed items
- Simple crafting progression

## 📦 Items

- **Jar**  
  Needed for jam crafting.

- **Sugar Cube**  
  Extra ingredient for recipes.

- **Sweet Berry Jam**  
  Regular jam.

- **Golden Sweet Berry Jam**  
  Golden version of sweet berry jam.
